```sql
SELECT c.region AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY order_count DESC
```

```sql
SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM memory.bench.customers
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region
```
